g.text: Conversion Signal Flow — From Click to Recorded Conversion
How the ad platform connects a browser-side action back to a specific ad click
STEP 5-8 THE CONVERSION JOURNEY (tags + platform backend)
STEP 9-10 THE LEARNING LOOP (how the algorithm uses the data)
Learning loop only becomes meaningful once conversion signal accumulates (typically 30-50 conversions per ad set for Meta,
30 per month for Google). Meta & Google also model conversions for privacy-limited browsers (no third-party cookie).
Solid = sequence; Conversion data feeds back (see red note below)
